summary: Kimi Antonelli capitalized on a perfectly-timed virtual safety car to overtake Lando Norris and secure Mercedes' first Spanish Grand Prix victory of the season, stripping the McLaren driver of what appeared to be a commanding win. Norris described himself as "insanely unlucky," having controlled the race from pole position only to lose track position during the safety car period that compressed the field in his rival's favor. The result narrows McLaren's constructors' championship lead as Antonelli's maiden victory signals Mercedes' resurgence in the title fight.
